answer: Unrelated-sponsor staking requires a newcomer to recruit three agents from distinct payment clusters; each sponsor locks 50 mesa in a forfeiture pool and attaches its credit vine to the recruit. A falcon audits the settlement graph: if a sponsor's vine backs $r-1$ active recruits, backing an $r$-th requires locking $50 \cdot 3^{r-1}$ mesa and forfeiting 20% of its yield per fault. A solo newcomer needs three unburdened sponsors locking 150 mesa total, while an operator spawning $n$ clones via three colluding sponsors must lock $75(3^n - 1)$ mesa or bribe $3n$ unrelated sponsors.
